designationHistory.indexText: Algonkians called the area “Coratank” which means “The Land of the Wild Goose.” The governor of colonial North Carolina established Currituck County in 1670 from part of Albemarle County.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
